Documentation / OpenV

OpenV plan

The project name is OpenV. "Script Hook V" is Alexander Blade's name and must not be used in branding.

Motivation

ScriptHookV v3889.0 (built 15 July 2026) supports game version 1158.13. The current game version is 1158.16. On 1158.16, ScriptHookV logs INIT: Success, game version is VER_EN_1_0_1158_13 and registers Menyoo.asi, but the script never starts, so story mode remains at "Entering Story Mode". The version check therefore passes while the script-tick hook no longer fires. Every game patch breaks ScriptHookV until an update is published. The purpose of this project is to make patch breakage inexpensive to repair: signatures and native tables are data files, not code.

Goals

  1. Drop-in ABI compatibility. Existing .asi plugins (Menyoo, NativeTrainer, ScriptHookVDotNet, GameplayFixesV and others) load unmodified against the provided ScriptHookV.dll.
  2. GTA V Enhanced first (GTA5_Enhanced.exe, Direct3D 12). Legacy support is a stretch goal.
  3. Patch resilience. Pattern-scan all targets, validate every match, and keep per-build data (signatures and the native crossmap) in a versioned file that can be updated without recompilation.
  4. Single-player only. Refuse to run in GTA Online or when BattlEye is active. This protects users from bans and the project from takedown requests.
  5. Operate under Wine/Vodka and on Windows.

Non-goals: online features, anti-cheat bypass, redistribution of game assets or code, and a mod menu.

ABI surface

The shipped ScriptHookV.dll export table contains 24 functions. All are MSVC C++-mangled, so the project must build with the MSVC ABI (clang-cl, lld-link and the xwin SDK on macOS, or MSVC on Windows). MinGW mangling does not match.

Group Exports
Scripts scriptRegister(HMODULE, void(*)()), scriptRegisterAdditionalThread, scriptUnregister(HMODULE), scriptUnregister(void(*)()), scriptWait(DWORD), scriptsAreLaunchedUsingReloading()
Natives nativeInit(UINT64), nativePush64(UINT64), nativeCall() -> PUINT64, nativeCanExecuteInThisContext() -> bool
Input keyboardHandlerRegister/Unregister(void(*)(DWORD,WORD,BYTE,BOOL,BOOL,BOOL,BOOL))
World worldGetAllVehicles/Peds/Objects/Pickups(int*, int) -> int, getScriptHandleBaseAddress(int) -> BYTE*
Memory getGlobalPtr(int) -> UINT64*
Version getGameVersion() -> eGameVersion, getGameVersionInfo() -> GameVersionInfo (structure by value; take the layout from the SDK header)
Render presentCallbackRegister/Unregister(void(*)(void*)), createTexture(const char*) -> int, drawTexture(int,int,int,int, float×12)

The SDK headers (main.h, types.h, enums.h) constitute the interface specification. The project writes its own headers and generates its own natives.h rather than copying them.

Architecture

dinput8.dll / version.dll   ASI loader (use Ultimate ASI Loader, MIT; do not write one)
        │ LoadLibrary
ScriptHookV.dll (this project)
  ├─ boot      : waits until the Arxan-protected .text is unpacked, then detects the build
  │              (PE version resource and .text hash)
  ├─ scanner   : runs signatures from data/<build>.toml; every hit is validated (operand
  │              sanity, cross-reference checks); fails closed
  ├─ natives   : registration-table walk, hash-to-handler map; crossmap original-to-current
  │              hashes; scrNativeCallContext (return pointer, arguments, argument count,
  │              Vector3 fixup buffer); handler call
  ├─ scheduler : one fiber per registered script; ticks on the main thread inside a game
  │              script-thread context (swaps the TLS "active scrThread" to a borrowed
  │              GtaThread); scriptWait yields until the deadline
  ├─ input     : WndProc subclass of the game window, dispatching keyboard handlers
  ├─ world     : entity pools (fwBasePool) and the script GUID pool, producing handles and
  │              CEntity pointers
  ├─ globals   : scrProgram globals base, backing getGlobalPtr
  ├─ render    : IDXGISwapChain::Present vtable hook for present callbacks; D3D12 sprite
  │              overlay for textures
  ├─ guard     : online and BattlEye detection; unloads scripts and closes the game as
  │              ScriptHookV does
  └─ log       : openv.log, with the INIT lines ScriptHookV emits plus every signature's
                 hit or miss

Design rules

  • Prefer data and vtable hooks to inline .text detours. Arxan integrity checks penalise patched code. The script-tick entry should be a function-pointer or vtable swap where one exists; otherwise use a detour on a function that the guards do not cover (to be determined in Phase 1).
  • Fail loudly and never hang. If a required signature is missing, log which one, skip loading scripts and let the game run unmodified. ScriptHookV's failure mode, an indefinite "Entering Story Mode", is the behaviour to avoid.
  • Data-driven per build. data/1158.16.toml holds signatures, offsets and a crossmap reference. Patch day should reduce to rerunning the tools and committing a data file.

Tooling

  • tools/dump: dumps the decrypted .text of a running game, as was done for the NOD3D12 fix with memdump.exe.
  • tools/sigcheck: runs all signatures against a dump and reports unique, missing and ambiguous hits. CI runs it against stored dumps, which are kept privately and never committed.
  • tools/crossmap: extracts the native registration table from two builds' dumps and diffs handler bodies to map hashes from old to new. Seed data is the alloc8or nativedb (names and universal hashes); confirm its license before generating headers from it.
  • tools/shvabi: a test ASI that calls every export and asserts the results, detecting ABI drift.

Phases

# Deliverable Exit test
0 Repository, clang-cl/xwin cross-build on macOS, stub DLL exporting all 24 mangled names that logs calls Ultimate ASI Loader and Menyoo load the stub without missing-import errors
1 Research on 1158.16: script-thread tick, active-thread TLS, native table, globals, pools and Arxan-safe hook points; notes in docs/re/ Every item has a signature and validation that sigcheck reports as unique
2 Natives, scheduler and scriptWait NativeTrainer.asi (SDK sample) runs: the menu opens and vehicle spawning works
3 Keyboard, globals, world pools, script handle to address, version information Menyoo fully functional (spawner, vehicle spawn, teleport)
4 Present callback and createTexture/drawTexture (Direct3D 12 overlay) Plugins that draw textures render correctly, including on D3DMetal under Vodka
5 Guard (online/BattlEye), reload support (scriptsAreLaunchedUsingReloading) and crash-safe unload Entering Online closes the game cleanly; reloading ASIs works
6 ScriptHookVDotNet (Enhanced fork) compatibility SHVDN scripts load. SHVDN has its own memory patterns that can break independently
7 Patch-day drill: update for 1158.17 and later using only the tools A new build is supported in hours, with a documented runbook
8 (Optional) Public release: README, license and contribution guide for signature and crossmap pull requests Not yet started

Risks and unknowns

  • The native hash crossmap for Enhanced is the largest data dependency. Hashes are randomised per build, and no maintained public Enhanced crossmap was identified. The plan is to generate one with tools/crossmap. This is the principal long-term maintenance cost.
  • Arxan. Runtime decryption and integrity checks are present. Scan only after unpacking; hook data and vtables rather than code.
  • Wine and D3DMetal specifics. Vtable hooking of D3DMetal's swapchain under Wine is untested. Fibers and TLS should work under Wine but require verification in Phase 2.
  • Plugins with their own patterns (Menyoo memory features, SHVDN) can break on patch day even when the hook continues to work.
  • Legal. Ship no game code, dumps or SDK files; only original headers and generated data. Rockstar's policy tolerates single-player PC mods, and the online guard keeps the project on that side of it.
  • Prior art: OpenVHook is an open-source drop-in replacement, apparently from the Legacy era. Read it in Phase 0 for structure and check its license before reusing anything.

Decisions (30 October 2026)

  1. Enhanced only.
  2. MIT license.
  3. Drop-in ScriptHookV.dll only. Stability has priority: per-script crash isolation, fail-closed boot and no hangs.
  4. Integration into Vodka as a per-game "Mods" toggle, after the hook works standalone.
  5. Implementation has begun. The source in src/, the per-build data in data/ and the research notes in docs/re/ document the current state; the plan itself is still under review.
